lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of circular high-luminance pixel groups of varying diameters, arranged in roughly horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral and dorsal-lateral surfaces.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges along the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-intensity upper edges and corresponding shadow-induced gradients immediately below.
